scope: Local full native-capture integration candidate; not native execution or publication

findings.issue: Caller dictionary replacement after verification changes the source bytes subsequently compiled.
findings.reproduction: A harmless in-memory sentinel replaces the collector source; the candidate executes that unverified replacement.
findings.proposedFix: Snapshot all five immutable byte references once, then verify, parse and compile only the private snapshot.

findings.issue: The final elapsed timer can observe20s yet leave successful consistency flags unchanged.
findings.proposedFix: Make the terminal time sample govern both elapsed metadata and successful verdict; reject expired, invalid or regressed time.

findings.issue: Elapsed metadata is added after the report size check.
findings.proposedFix: Finalize all metadata before checking the complete returned report, including failure paths.
